title: Petition of Boston Edison Company for a determination by the Department that the present situation of certain lands in the City of Boston lying on the northly side of East First Street in South Boston and the proposed construction, maintenance and operation thereon of certain buildings and structures which are to be used for the conversion to coal of Petitioner's existing electrical generating station presently located upon such premises, are reasonably necesary for the convenience or welfare of the public and that such lands and the facilities to be built and maintained thereon be exempted from the operation of the zoning order of the City of Boston to the extent applicable, under the provisions of Sec. 6 of Chapter 665 of the Acts of 1956 from the operation of the zoning code of the City of Boston.
